title: Rathbreaker Boss Guide: Spear Rush, Volley Timing and Early Act 2 Preparation
summary: Act 2 early-wall boss in Vastiri Outskirts. Learn the Slash Combo finisher, Spear Rush tell, off-map spear volley and the current Fire-vs-Cold relationship before you push on.
description: How to beat Rathbreaker in Path of Exile 2 Act 2: arena reading, attack response table, pre-fight preparation, build strategy and video timestamps.
author: Exile2 Guides
imageAlt: Rathbreaker raising a spear on the Vastiri Outskirts cliffs

sections.title: Remember These First
sections.callout: Do not facetank the Slash Combo finisher — sidestep only after the third swing starts.
calloutDetail: Rathbreaker is the first real Act 2 wall because incoming damage jumps and the arena funnels you into spear landing zones.
Clear the Hyena adds that pinch your movement space before committing to the boss.

answers.label: Before the fight
answers.text: Check life, resistances and movement speed. Fire damage now pressures Rathbreaker more than before, but do not abandon cold/physical defence.

answers.label: During the fight
answers.text: Watch for the spear-plant tell (Spear Rush) and the overhead sword (Slam). Move after the telegraph, not before.

answers.label: After deaths
answers.text: Identify which attack killed you, then read that row in the attack table instead of swapping all gear.

facts.label: Campaign stage
facts.note: Reached after crossing into the Vastiri Outskirts. Part of the Earning Passage objective.

facts.label: Fight type
facts.note: No phase reset; pressure comes from adds plus ranged spears.

facts.label: On death
facts.note: No material cost. Respawn just outside the arena.

facts.label: After victory
facts.note: Defeating Rathbreaker opens the next main objective with Rudja.

steps.label: Enter Vastiri Outskirts
body: From the Act 2 entry, follow the cliff path.
The arena is gated until the Earning Passage objective is active.

steps.label: Reach the arena ledge
body: Hyenas and ranged support spawn on the approach — thin them on the way up.

items.label: Life and base defences
checks: Prevents the Slash Combo finisher from deleting you.
items.why: The third swing deals the largest hit and often follows a combo.
items.fix: Swap in a higher-tier chest or add life/resist affixes before the fight.

items.label: Movement speed
checks: Decides whether you leave the Spear Rush line in time.
items.why: The dash locks a line and punishes slow characters.
items.fix: Prioritise boots with movement speed; a magic pair helps immediately.

items.label: Add clear
items.why: Ranged support forces you off safe lanes.
items.fix: Keep one low-cost AoE skill for add control.

items.label: Damage type
checks: Current build can bring Fire pressure.
items.why: Rathbreaker is comparatively more exposed to Fire than at 0.2.0.
items.fix: Treat Fire as a bonus, not a requirement — keep cold/physical covered.

items.label: Visibility
checks: Can you see the sword-plant tell through effects?
items.why: Cluttered visuals hide the Slam wind-up.
items.fix: Lower non-essential effect density and keep the boss on screen.

sections.title: Arena Reading
paragraphs: The arena is a sloped plateau with a cliff edge on one side. Rathbreaker uses the edge to line up charges, and off-map spears land in marked arcs rather than from his body.
Keep to the open centre. The cliff wall removes your escape route for the next attack, exactly like Count Geonor's wall problem in Act 1.
bullets: Blue = observation lane. Orange = Spear Rush path. Red = volley overlap. Green = safe output after a dodge.

phases.label: Phase 1: Single Arena Fight
objectives: Dodge Spear Rush after the plant tell
notes: One continuous fight, no reset. Pressure scales with adds and ranged spears, not a phase change.
Save recovery for the Slash Combo finisher window.

attacks.name: Slash Combo
telegraph: Three overhead swings; the last has a longer wind-up.
responses: Roll or step to the side-rear after the third swing begins.
commonMistakes: Panic-rolling on swing one and exhausting space before the finisher.
notes: The finisher is the kill shot; do not trade during it.

attacks.name: Spear Rush
telegraph: Plants spear in ground, pulls back, locks a line.
responses: Move laterally once the line locks; do not roll early.
commonMistakes: Rolling before the lock-in, then getting re-aimed.
notes: Leaves a follow-up thrust if you stay in the lane.

attacks.name: Sword Slam
telegraph: Raises sword overhead with a brief pause.
responses: Step out of the impact ring, then return for a window.
commonMistakes: Standing inside the ring because it looks small.
notes: Creates the best melee window after the slam.

attacks.name: Off-map Spear Volley
telegraph: Marked arcs appear on the ground from off-screen.
responses: Walk out of the arcs; they are not body projectiles.
commonMistakes: Assuming the spears come from Rathbreaker and dodging the wrong way.
notes: These are environment spears, not a boss projectile — move to the gap.

attacks.name: Hyena / Add Pressure
responses: Clear only adds blocking your path.
commonMistakes: Chasing distant adds and losing boss visibility.
notes: Adds that do not block you are not worth the reposition cost.

types.label: Physical
notes: Most of the combo and rush damage is physical.

types.label: Fire
mitigation: Fire resistance helps but is a secondary pressure.
notes: Rathbreaker is comparatively more exposed to Fire than at 0.2.0; bringing Fire is a bonus, not a requirement.

types.label: Cold
mitigation: Cold resistance covers any cold support tags.
notes: Less prominent than physical, but keep it covered.

sections.title: Strategy and Key Mechanics
paragraphs: Melee: do not glue to the boss. Learn the Slash Combo end, then land a short rotation during the Sword Slam window.
Ranged: keep mid-distance lateral movement. Retreating to the cliff wall is the most common death — stay centre and step sideways.
Minion: keep the character moving; do not stand still because minions deal damage.
Low movement: pre-position before each telegraph; use only the shortest animations; react to the start of the tell, not the full danger zone.
bullets: If damage feels low, verify your single-target setup before upgrading gear.
If survival fails, split life, resistances and movement space into three independent checks.

rewards.label: Act 2 Progression
notes: Completes the Earning Passage step and opens Mawdun Mine (Rudja).
Standard boss loot table drops as normal.

entries.question: Why do I die to the last hit of the combo even with decent gear?
summary: Players describe surviving swings one and two, then dying to the finisher while mid-animation.
editorialAnalysis: This is a timing problem, not purely a gear problem — the finisher lands as players start a long cast.
officialAnswer: Stop attacking the moment the third swing winds up. Reposition, then return for the Sword Slam window.

entries.question: Are the off-map spears Rathbreaker's projectiles?
summary: Some players dodge toward the boss, thinking the spears originate from him.
editorialAnalysis: They are environment volleys in marked arcs, not body projectiles.
officialAnswer: Move to the gap between arcs. Do not roll into the boss.

entries.question: Should I switch my whole build to Fire?
summary: Community posts highlight Rathbreaker's Fire weakness since 0.2.0.
editorialAnalysis: Fire is a real bonus but not a requirement; abandoning cold/physical defence is a net loss.
officialAnswer: Keep your defences balanced. Add Fire only if your build already supports it.

problems.symptom: I keep dying to the Slash Combo finisher.
directAnswer: The finisher lands as you start a long animation. Stop attacking when the third swing winds up and reposition.
checks: Watch the overhead pause before swing three.
Save a dodge for the finisher, not swing one.
Confirm life/resist are not trivially low.

problems.symptom: Why am I suddenly easy to kill in Act 2?
directAnswer: Incoming damage steps up at Act 2 entry. Re-check life, resistances and movement speed together, not just DPS.
checks: Compare your chest/rings to Act 2 expectations.
Confirm you are not standing in volley arcs.

problems.symptom: Should I clear all the Hyenas first?
directAnswer: Only clear adds blocking your path or interrupting you. Distant adds are not worth losing boss visibility.
checks: Chasing edge adds costs telegraph information.
If adds block retreat, clear the nearest one.
